name: Tinoon
description: Tinoon was a planet located within the Tinoon system of the Outer Rim Territories relatively close to the Zephry Asteroid field. The planet's orbit was home to a customs check point and a Cargo Facility. It was raided by pirates after the Battle of Hoth.
